Package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.statemachines

package sysmlinjava.javaannotations.statemachines
Annotations used to declare field variables as an element or type of a SysML state (machine). SysMLinJava uses the annotations on fields to recognize and identify the elements that comprise the SysMLinJava model.
